user.title: Add Anker Prime chargers
user.description: Choose how the chargers are reached.

menu_options.cloud: Anker account (Prime Charger 250W, over the cloud)

cloud.title: Anker account
cloud.description: Sign in with the Anker account your chargers are bound to. A second account, with the chargers shared to it, keeps the Anker app's login untouched.

data_description.country: The country chosen when the Anker account was created; it selects Anker's server.

chargers.title: Chargers
chargers.description: Choose the chargers to add. Each becomes a device.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Anker no longer accepts the stored login of {email}. Enter the account password.

bluetooth_pick.title: Bluetooth charger
bluetooth_pick.description: Chargers advertising near your Bluetooth adapters and proxies.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Anker Prime 160W
bluetooth_confirm.description: Home Assistant connects to the charger at {address} once to check access. Close the Anker app first: the charger accepts one Bluetooth connection at a time, and while Home Assistant keeps it connected the app cannot reach it (see the options).

data_description.owner_id: User ID of the Anker account the charger is bound to (shown by the anker-prime-driver CLI after login, and prefilled from a configured Anker account). Newer firmware only accepts this account; leave empty to try without.

reauth_owner.title: Charger refuses access
reauth_owner.description: {name} refuses the identity Home Assistant uses and sends no data. Enter the user ID of the Anker account the charger is bound to.

error.invalid_input: Check the email, password and country.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Anker cloud or the charger.
error.not_in_range: The charger is not in range of a connectable Bluetooth adapter or proxy.
error.owner_refused: The charger refused this identity; enter the ID of the Anker account it is bound to.

abort.no_chargers: No charger reachable through the Anker cloud is bound to this account.
abort.wrong_account: This is a different Anker account than the one set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No Anker Prime 160W found nearby. Check that it is powered, that the Anker app is closed, and that a Bluetooth adapter or proxy is in range.
abort.wrong_charger: The charger at this address is a different one than the one set up.

data_description.update_interval: Seconds; 0 updates entities on every reading (about once a second). Energy is counted at the full rate either way.

bluetooth.title: Connection
bluetooth.description: The charger accepts one Bluetooth connection at a time. While the connection is kept open, readings are live but the Anker app cannot connect; otherwise Home Assistant connects for each read and each command, and the app can connect in between.

data.read_interval: Read interval without a kept connection

data_description.update_interval: Seconds; 0 updates entities on every reading (about once a second). Energy is counted at the full rate either way.
data_description.keep_connection: Live readings, about once a second.
data_description.read_interval: Seconds between reads when the connection is not kept. Energy between reads up to two minutes apart is interpolated; longer gaps count nothing.

charger_offline.title: {name} is offline
charger_offline.description: No readings have arrived from {name} for more than 30 minutes. Check that the charger is powered and connected to Wi-Fi. This notice disappears when it is back.

charger_offline_bluetooth.title: {name} is offline
charger_offline_bluetooth.description: No readings have arrived from {name} for more than 30 minutes. Check that the charger is powered and in range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy, and that the Anker app is not holding the connection. This notice disappears when it is back.

set_schedule.name: Set output schedule
set_schedule.description: Sets the daily power-on or power-off time of an output.

time.name: Time
time.description: Time of day; seconds are ignored.

weekdays.name: Weekdays
weekdays.description: Days to repeat on; none means once.

disable_schedule.name: Disable output schedule
disable_schedule.description: Switches an output schedule off, keeping its time and days.

start_countdown.name: Start countdown
start_countdown.description: Switches the output off after the given time.

set_clock_schedule.name: Set clock schedule
set_clock_schedule.description: Sets when the clock screensaver is shown. Target the clock screensaver switch.

weekdays.name: Weekdays
weekdays.description: Days to show the clock on; none means every day.
